event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Singapore Straits Indonesia 01° 04.19' N 103° 27.00' E

sources.title: Piracy monthly report October 2023
sources.text: About four or five robbers armed with a gun and knives boarded a bulk carrier underway. They took hostage the third engineer and tied him up. Duty oiler noticed the robbers and raised the alarm resulting in the robbers escaping with stolen spare parts. Incident was reported to Singapore VTIS and the Singapore coast guard boarded the vessel for investigation.
